reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 19. Nay or No: 20. Not Voting: 0. Present or other: 1. Of 39 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 38 (97%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 208 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
Clean energy is cheap energy. Industrial-scale battery storage facilities like G&W Electric in Bolingbrook are helping Illinois reach its decarbonization goals, while also improving reliability and affordability.

https://t.co/1jkLnYmlc8

Applications for congressional nominations to the U.S. Military Service Academies close on November 15, 2026.

Learn more about the nomination process, eligibility requirements, and application on my website: https://t.co/8jfvyKQaKQ

Share holiday greetings with seniors through my office's Holiday Card Drive! This year, my office will be collecting cards to share with local senior facilities in IL-06. Mail or drop off your cards by Tuesday, December 1. https://t.co/5egjFke6dt

As a member of Congress, I am proud to secure Community Project Funding for initiatives in IL-06 that improve the day-to-day lives of constituents. 

I recently met with Mayor Klein in Crestwood to hear how Community Project Funding will help improve clean water supply to Crestwood residents.

Our veterans’ service is a debt that can never fully be repaid.

Earlier this year, I was honored to join the Military Warriors Support Foundation, Wells Fargo, Webb Chevy Oak Lawn, and members of our community to recognize Former U.S. Navy Aviation Boatswain's Mate (Handler) https://t.co/JMRJz1gayJ

The deadline is less than a week away to apply for my Spring 2027 Internship program in my Lombard and Washington, D.C. offices! The program offers civic-minded individuals an excellent opportunity to serve their community and contribute to the work of a congressional office. https://t.co/8tBfC7vM3L

America’s electric grid is under a tremendous amount of stress due to increasing extreme weather events and historic energy demand.

I recently toured G&W Electric and CellCube’s facility in Bolingbrook to see their 3.2 MW/11.8 MWh microgrid in action. https://t.co/pvHIOdh44X

Applications for congressional nominations to the U.S. Military Service Academies are open until November 15, 2026. Visit my website for more information about the application and the appointment process. 
https://t.co/8jfvyKQaKQ

Last week, I joined the West Suburban Chamber of Commerce and Industry and the Village of Hodgkins to share information about how my office can help constituents with federal agencies, federal grants, and Community Project Funding. https://t.co/DeQqL3M0fs

Interested in a career in public service? Applications for Spring 2027 internships in my Washington, DC and Illinois district offices are now open. Students with ties to Illinois' 6th District, a strong interest in public service, excellent communication and organizational skills, and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.
https://t.co/uD5aGoPx3f

I toured Thunderbolt Locks, Willow Florist Shop, and Noble Table Bistro with Willow Springs Village President Melissa Neddermeyer, Countryside Mayor Sean McDermott, and the West Suburban Chamber of Commerce and Industry. 

Small businesses are the backbone of our economy, and I’m https://t.co/2m6Lrq9eOM

A constituent in Lombard reached out to my office for assistance with their pending H-4 visa and Employment Authorization Document renewal applications. My team followed up with the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) on the constituent’s behalf, which helped https://t.co/nSxDBVHCuG

In the last year, energy prices have skyrocketed. I teamed up with Congressman Mike Levin to introduce the Energy Bills Relief Act, legislation to make energy cleaner, more reliable, and more affordable for families.

https://t.co/qprcf7DmaZ https://t.co/L5jev4wj2f

Both my Lombard and Washington, D.C. offices are accepting internship applications for my Spring 2027 internship program! 

If you are a civically-engaged college student, recent graduate, or graduate student with ties to IL-06, we encourage you to apply for an incredible https://t.co/4YmxBttLle

October is Domestic Violence Awareness Month. I convened a listening session with domestic violence advocacy organizations to hear about trends in reporting and how Congress can support survivors of domestic violence. https://t.co/HFNUn77nNv

I recently met with the team at Advantage Chevrolet. We discussed electric vehicle expansion in Illinois and affordability challenges in the auto industry. I also learned about their community engagement, including their entrepreneurial mentorship programs. https://t.co/DMuNgeYvJO

In Congress, I am committed to ensuring our veterans receive the benefits they have earned.

I joined American Legion T.H.B. Post 187’s monthly meeting to share my legislative priorities and to hear how Congress can better serve our nation’s veterans. https://t.co/AqHNrDL145

Earlier this week, I toured Hayes Beer Distributing Company in Alsip alongside Cook County-area state representatives and senators. We learned about the operations at the facility and the retail accounts they serve throughout the country. https://t.co/KIOTGI6dnb

Interested in attending a U.S. Service Academy? There’s still time to apply for a congressional nomination through my office.

Whether you’re preparing your application or know a student who should apply, visit my website for details on eligibility, requirements, and the nomination process.
https://t.co/3GMAgg4xy8

I recently introduced the Integrated Local, Regional, and Interregional Transmission Planning Act, legislation that will make electricity more affordable and reliable by increasing access to less expensive electricity.

I spoke to students in Northwestern University’s Clean Energy Law Class about my legislation and answered questions about clean energy policy.

https://t.co/vRTRIQKz90

Last week, I joined Mayor Ryan, the Alsip Fire Department, and Alsip Police Department for the annual Project Fire Buddies community blood drive. Project Fire Buddies partners with fire departments across the country to bring joy to children struggling with illnesses. https://t.co/Da28AR9BfL

Delayed tax returns can be extremely frustrating. When a constituent in Tinley Park was having trouble receiving their 2024 tax return, they reached out to my office for help. My team worked with the constituent and the Taxpayer Advocate Service (TAS) to address a discrepancy https://t.co/9vEa6IiffF

October is National Book Month. I met with the team at the Tri-Town YMCA in Villa Park and dropped off books from the Library of Congress Surplus Books Program for young readers in our community.

Interested in receiving books for your organization? Check out my website to learn https://t.co/poCfTR9yRM

LGBTQIA+ rights are human rights.

I proudly stand with LGBTQIA+ Americans in IL-06 and across the country, and I’m grateful to receive a 100% on @HRC's Congressional Scorecard for my record of fighting back against attacks on equality. https://t.co/4SjkIcO2pe

My office is seeking qualified undergraduate students, recent graduates, and graduate students for my Spring 2027 Internship program.

Candidates with a passion for public service and ties to IL-06 are strongly encouraged to apply at: https://t.co/c6pCQ5hMp0 https://t.co/Qoxi18EfqS

I recently visited Ignite Graphics Group, a woman-owned small business in Elmhurst. We discussed challenges from COVID-era supply chain shortages, COVID Economic Injury Disaster Loans, and how small businesses have worked to recover in the last few years. https://t.co/f10SHiu7FF

The 2026 Congressional App Challenge is open to middle and high school students with all levels of coding experience. 

The deadline to submit apps is next Monday, October 26. Visit my website to learn more about the program. https://t.co/gnMwYUBRJG https://t.co/BfyPg2bC9e

Upcoming travel plans? Make sure your passport is up-to-date.

If you’re dealing with passport delays or issues with federal agencies, my office is here to help you get back on track.

https://t.co/Osk6GWiaYW https://t.co/mphy1bP4gK

Applications are still open for congressional nominations to the U.S. Military Service Academies. Learn more about the nomination process, eligibility requirements, and application on my website: https://t.co/8jfvyKQaKQ https://t.co/SWxoDKAICX

I’m happy to announce that applications for my Spring 2027 Internship program have opened to undergraduate students, recent graduates, and enrolled graduate students!

Applicants with ties to IL-06 are encouraged to learn more and apply at: https://t.co/c6pCQ5hMp0 https://t.co/7BlBNFuwuL

I recently honored my latest Constituent Spotlight, Officer Silvia Rupcich from the Willowbrook Police Department. Officer Rupcich started Willowbrook’s Shop with a Cop Program, which spreads holiday cheer and supports children and families in our community. 

Know someone who makes IL-06 a brighter place? Nominate them on my website. https://t.co/ZQp717HfA3

Hispanic Heritage Month celebrates the contributions and rich culture of America’s Hispanic communities. I visited Toro Construction in Orland Park and JP Architects in Oak Lawn to learn about Hispanic-owned and operated businesses in IL-06. https://t.co/aXtyvxUHXP

ICYMI: I was proud to secure $950,000 in federal funding for Elmhurst University’s Health Sciences Department. The funding will be used to install state of the art technology and research equipment, which will provide hands-on opportunities for future healthcare leaders. 

https://t.co/E8P0hctZgI

Donald Trump's tariffs are driving inflation and making life more expensive. This is exactly why I have voted multiple times to put an end to these unconstitutional, costly policies.

https://t.co/TwaKmeBcXj

This morning, I hosted a roundtable discussion on rising housing costs with DuPage Pads, CEDA, Bridge Communities, Neighborhood Housing Services of Chicago, DuPage and Chicago South Suburbs Habitat for Humanity, BEDS Plus, Illinois Realtors, and representatives from local townships.

I learned how the increasing cost of living is affecting housing in IL-06, and how organizations continue to navigate changes at the federal level to meet the high demand for affordable housing.

Applications are now open for congressional nominations to the U.S. Military Service Academies!

Visit my website for more information about the application and the appointment process. https://t.co/8jfvyKQaKQ

Applications for the 2026 Congressional App Challenge are now open! 

The Congressional App Challenge is open to all middle and high school students in Illinois’ 6th Congressional District. For rules and more information, visit my website. 
https://t.co/gnMwYUBRJG https://t.co/J8RpeALkNv

Members of Congress have the unique privilege of nominating eligible candidates to the U.S. Military Service Academies.

Learn more about the nomination process, eligibility requirements, and application on my website: https://t.co/8jfvyKQaKQ

Last week, I met with the team from We Are Creed in Burr Ridge and delivered books from the Library of Congress Surplus Books Program, which donates books to educational institutions, public agencies, and nonprofit tax-exempt agencies with the purpose of building library collections.

Check out my website to learn more about the Library of Congress Surplus Books Program. https://t.co/auFu9Bubk5

NEWS: Yesterday, the Senate passed two pilot mental health bills I introduced in the House. Together, they would make it easier for pilots and air traffic controllers to seek mental health care.

Since the legislation was amended by the Senate, we'll need to pass both bills in the House before they can become law. But we're one step closer to meaningful change.

Read why these issues are important:
https://t.co/5lsnq8wnPg

A constituent in Glen Ellyn was receiving reduced Social Security disability benefits because the Social Security Administration (SSA) had not updated its records to reflect the closure of their Workers’ Compensation case. My team helped gather the necessary documentation and worked with the agency to review the case. Following our outreach, the SSA updated the constituent’s record and increased their benefits.

Are you having trouble with a federal agency? Reach out to my office and let us help. https://t.co/kxRIHlgDgg

Applications are now open for congressional nominations to the U.S. Military Service Academies!

Visit my website for more information about the application and the appointment process. 

https://t.co/8jfvyKQaKQ https://t.co/KBobPITZV0

This National Literacy Month, I’m grateful to the libraries in IL-06 that help foster a love of reading. From Wheaton to Prairie Trails, each of these institutions plays a critical part in expanding access to books, supporting lifelong learning, and strengthening our communities. https://t.co/PjuXOCT6pc

I had the pleasure of honoring my latest Constituent Spotlight, Cindy Crosby, for her decades of volunteer service at The Morton Arboretum. As a dragonfly monitoring group leader, prairie restoration volunteer, educator, and author of more than 20 books, she inspires people to protect and appreciate our local biodiversity.

Thank you, Cindy, for your decades of service and dedication to cultivating the next generation of environmental stewards!

I joined Senators Whitehouse and Merkley to introduce the Environmental Health Restoration Act to restore the EPA’s mission and reinstate protections for our health and environment.

I’ll keep fighting to protect our clean air, water, and communities.
Read more about the bill here:

https://t.co/iNzOZ6f2Xs

https://t.co/HDUBEJZUmt

I was proud to join Garden Center Services in celebrating the grand opening of the Garden Apartments in Worth, providing adults with disabilities the opportunity to live independently in safe, affordable housing. This is an important step toward building more inclusive communities, and I’m grateful to everyone who helped make it possible.

The 2026 Congressional App Challenge application is now open! 

The Congressional App Challenge is open to all middle and high school students in Illinois’ 6th Congressional District. Check out my website to learn more. https://t.co/gnMwYUBRJG https://t.co/pbJsVGE1xi

When a former federal employee in Westmont experienced delays in receiving retirement benefits, they turned to my office for help. My team reached out to the Social Security Administration to advocate on their behalf, and the constituent began receiving their monthly benefits of $2,400. 

Are you having trouble with a federal agency? Reach out to my office and let us help. 

https://t.co/kxRIHlgDgg

I visited Mariano's in Lombard to meet with store employees and the Kroger Health team. Their team shared how they partner with the Greater Chicago Food Depository and non-profits in the Chicagoland area to give back to the community.

We also discussed how their pharmacy staff works with the retail team to provide personalized experiences for customers.

I'm proud to have helped secure $500,000 in federal funding for the Lake Michigan Regional Water Supply Initiative, which will help strengthen our local water infrastructure and ensure communities in DuPage County have access to safe, reliable water for generations to come.

At a time when the Trump Administration is ignoring the climate crisis and undermining Americans’ ability to breathe clean air, drink clean water, and enjoy the outdoors, it's more important than ever to restore a commitment to science-based environmental protection at the EPA.

Yesterday, alongside Senator Sheldon Whitehouse, I introduced the Environmental Health Restoration Act to do just that.

Read more: https://t.co/iNzOZ6f2Xs

I’m voting NO on the Russia sanctions bill.

Standing with Ukraine and holding Russia accountable should not require Congress to hand the President broad new authority to impose tariffs of up to 100% on other countries.
This bill gives the President too much unchecked power at a time when Americans are already paying the price for his reckless tariffs.

Here’s why I can’t support it:

I pressed Secretary Bessent for answers about billions of dollars from Venezuelan oil sales routed through a Qatari bank account and who ultimately has access to those funds.

The American people deserve transparency about where this money is going and who is benefiting from it. https://t.co/dQlLSRrraA

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
